component.name: Brilliant Launcher
輝煌啟動器
component.summary: Minecraft launcher for the Brilliant server
輝煌伺服器的 Minecraft 啟動器

description.p: A Minecraft launcher made for the Brilliant server, with Microsoft login, one-click server joining, Modrinth mods and resource packs, mod profiles, world backups and imports from other launchers.
輝煌伺服器的 Minecraft 啟動器：微軟正版登入、一鍵直連分流、Modrinth 模組與資源包、模組組合、存檔備份，並可從其他啟動器匯入。
